text_blocks.snippet: A cold and COVID-19 share some overlapping symptoms like a sore throat, runny/stuffy nose, and sneezing. However, COVID-19 is more likely to cause tiredness, and a loss of taste or smell, which are less common with a cold. While both can cause a cough and mild fever, these are more frequently associated with the flu and COVID-19.
